facts.text: I am in the process of buying a house.
I saw a first house listed for $425,000.
I found a better deal on a different property than the first house I saw.
I ended up finding a house for $350,000.
I want to know if I can negotiate with the seller to cover some of the closing costs.
I will discuss the situation with my agent, Rachel.
I have already had a home inspection.
I want to know if I can use the home inspection results to negotiate with the seller to fix issues or lower the price.
I am thinking of asking the seller to fix a small leak in the roof.
I am thinking of asking the seller to replace worn-out carpeting in the bedrooms.
I will ask Rachel to reach out to the seller to request that they fix the roof leak and replace the worn-out carpeting in the bedrooms.
I want to ask the seller for a credit towards closing costs or a reduction in the sale price if they are unwilling to make the repairs.
I think I will ask Rachel to request a $2,000 credit towards closing costs if the seller is unwilling to make the repairs.
I think I will ask Rachel to request a $2,500 reduction in the sale price if the seller is unwilling to make the repairs.

events.text: First house viewed was listed for $425,000.
Found a house for $350,000 for calculations.
Planned request to fix a small roof leak and replace worn-out bedroom carpeting.
Planned for Rachel to contact the seller to request roof leak repair and carpet replacement.
Planned request for $2,000 credit towards closing costs or $2,500 sale price reduction if repairs are not made.
